name: Rails Mass Assignment via params.permit!
attack_scenario: Attacker adds "admin":true or "role":"admin" to the form body; because permit! trusts all keys, the flag is persisted and the account is privilege-escalated.
negative_test_hint: include "user[role]=admin" in the update request body and assert the role attribute is ignored because only explicitly permitted keys are applied

exemplar.explanation: params.permit! whitelists every attribute in the request, defeating Strong Parameters entirely — the client can set any model column including admin/role/verified flags. Always enumerate the exact permitted attributes.
